title: Signal: Requirements file that trusts an additional host
scope: A requirements.txt file that declares a `--trusted-host` entry that turns TLS verification off for that host.
limitations: It matches a `--trusted-host` entry that turns TLS verification off for that host in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A requirements.txt that mentions a `--trusted-host` entry that turns TLS verification off for that host in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
